record.question: What is the primary cause of renovascular hypertension in young women?
record.explanation: Answer B: Fibromuscular dysplasia. Renal-artery fibromuscular dysplasia is a classic cause of renovascular hypertension in younger women; atherosclerotic renal artery disease is more typical in older people with vascular risk factors. Reference: https://vascular.org/your-vascular-health/vascular-conditions/fibromuscular-disease; https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/33/3021/5079119. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
